title.value: An act to add Chapter 12.5 (commencing with Section 108945) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to product safety

location.provenance: An act to add Chapter 12.5 (commencing with Section 108945) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code

pfas_definition.provenance: Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom

type.provenance: On and after July 1, 2023, a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer, shall not sell or distribute in commerce in this state any new, not previously owned, juvenile product that contains regulated PFAS chemicals

exceptions: internal component of a juvenile product that would not come into direct contact with a child's skin or mouth during reasonably foreseeable use and abuse of the product

intentionally_added.provenance: Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom
